item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q001_histone_related_proteins","answer":"In the current SCOPe release 2.08, canonical nucleosome histones are in class a, All alpha proteins, fold a.22, Histone-fold, superfamily a.22.1, Histone-fold. SCOPe places several non-core-histone groups in the same a.22.1 superfamily, so they are histone-fold homologs at the superfamily level but are separated into distinct families: a.22.1.2 Archaeal histone, represented by the Archaeal histone protein node; a.22.1.3 TBP-associated factors, TAFs, which also contains CHRAC-14, CHRAC-16, the Son of sevenless histone domain, NC2 alpha and beta chains, NF-YB/NF-YC subunits, and several TAF(II) histone-fold domains; and a.22.1.4 Bacterial histone-fold protein, including Aq_328 and TTHA1479. The ordinary eukaryotic nucleosome core histones H2A, H2B, H3, H4, plus macro-H2A.1 histone domain, remain together in the closer a.22.1.1 Nucleosome core histones family. The fold a.22 has only this one curated superfamily in SCOPe 2.08, but the distinction still matters: SCOPe reports homology as implied at superfamily and family levels, while the fold and class levels by themselves are structural groupings and must not be used to transfer detailed nucleosome function, binding specificity, or template annotations indiscriminately. Automated-match bins under these families are release-specific placement buckets rather than curated new biological families.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.22","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.22.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.22/children?limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.22.1/children?limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47114/children?limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47129/children?limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47134/children?limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101318/children?limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47112/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47113/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47114/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47129/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47134/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101318/homology"]}]}
